entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
This is second application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail who has been arrested on 10.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.494 of 2019 registered at Police Station Karera,
District Shivpuri for offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 13th of January, 2023 passed in MCRC 61339 of 2022.
According to prosecution case, the allegation against the present applicant is that he was a witness to the forged Will.
Therefore, an offence has been registered against the present applicant vide aforesaid crime No.494 of 2019.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
The applicant is a witness to the forged will.
Applicant is in custody since 10-12-2022.
After completion of investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take time.

Co-accused Manoj Kumar has been extended benefit of bail by this Court by order dated 26.04.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.16495/2023.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer of the applicant for grant of bail and prayed for rejection of application.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary as well as charge sheet.
Looking to the aforesaid facts & circumstances of the case as well as the fact that applicant is in custody since 10-12-2022, charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of trial will take some time

,
without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash surety of Rs.25,000/- alongwith personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of default, cash surety of Rs. 25,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
Subject to aforesaid conditions, present application stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ojha Mitthanlal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31052597/
